real: General Atomics MQ-1C Gray Eagle (the old builder's choice)
AGM-114 Hellfire on M299 twin rails
shape: No unit_refs / unit_sheet row; mb_p27_standins drew it as an MQ-1C Gray Eagle (slim wing, inverted-V tail, satcom hump, four Hellfires; 4.25 x 8.04 x 1.24 m, the def's modelSize). Rebuilt on the same reference: the slim fuselage with the bulbous satcom nose, the EO/IR ball under the chin, the long straight high wing, the inverted-V tail with the ventral fin, the pusher propeller behind the heavy-fuel engine, two twin Hellfire rails.

features.feature: slim fuselage with the bulbous satcom nose, access panels, aerials
EO/IR sensor ball under the chin with its window
the engine bay: the dorsal intake, the cooler scoop, the exhaust stubs
long straight high wing with flaperons and wing-tip lights
inverted-V tail with the ventral fin
two pylons with M299 twin rails and four Hellfires

weapons.note: 1 barrel; Muzzle_missile.001 on the other wing (kept from the old file)
